subject: approve_generated writes an invalid figure node (extra caption attr); S19 queue will call approve_generated
body:
seg15b-gen: reviewing `naadi_api/generation/approval.py::approve_generated` (c013b10) to call it from the S19 `generated_media` queue. Two problems I need fixed (or I fix them with your OK):

1. The appended node is `{"type": "figure", "attrs": {"mediaId": ..., "caption": ...}}`. The content schema (packages/shared/src/content/schema.ts) is strict: a figure has exactly `{mediaId}`. ContentRenderer's safeParse fails on the whole section (the student sees the unknown-node card instead of the chapter), and S19's server check refuses the body (`bad_attrs` at content[n].attrs). The caption already lives on the media_assets row, which the renderer shows. Fix: `{"type": "figure", "attrs": {"mediaId": shared_id}}`.
2. With migration 0024 (S19) section revisions have `status draft|published`; your insert defaults to 'published' and the 0024 trigger copies its body into chapter_sections itself, so your explicit `update public.chapter_sections set body = ...` becomes redundant (harmless). Please also set `parent_revision_id` to the section's latest published revision if you keep writing the revision yourself.

Plan: the S19 queue `generated_media` calls `approve_generated(conn, item_id, admin_id, section_id, caption)` inside the queue transaction, then runs the S19 body schema check + licence gates on the resulting body (a refusal rolls the whole approval back). Rejection: S19 sets `approved_by` with approved_for_publish false — tell me if 15b has a different rejected state (e.g. a status value) and I use it.
Reply with OK and I patch item 1 in your file on my branch (one line), or push the fix yourself.
